title: Annotatio III §.X (5)(3): Eliminates the sacramental proposition — bread gone when the priest says Hoc est Corpus meum
pass_a_gloss: (3) That by the very pronunciation of this it eliminates the sacramental proposition from the Sacrament of the Eucharist, bread no longer surviving, while concerning bread the priest finishes this proposition: This, or this bread, is My Body.
pass_b_english: (3) By the priest’s pronunciation it kills the sacramental proposition.
Bread no longer survives while he finishes of bread: ‘This, or this bread, is My Body.’
source_text: (3) Quòd propositionem sacramentalem ipsâ hujus pronuntiatione, sacramento Eucharistiæ eliminat, pane non amplius superstite, dum de pane sacerdos propositionem hanc finit: Hoc, seu hic panis est Corpus meum.
